records.title: Vehicle pose layers compose with the active world dictionary
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3; locally supplied stock and reconstructed-world animation dictionaries, 2026-10-11
records.observation: An installed full-dictionary pose override was bypassed by alternate-world selection. A validated eleven-clip layer now composes after world selection; 236 slots and 225 unrelated animations are retained, with identical native samples for unaffected clips.
records.limitations: Production loader/compression/interpolation and activation fixtures passed; rendered seating, contacts and transitions were not tested. Game-derived inputs and private runtime implementation are withheld.

records.title: Passenger pose selection must follow occupant role
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64, version 0.2.134, 2026-10-11
records.observation: A script-created opening passenger, native spawned passengers and directly warped passengers selected driver clips despite successful layer activation. Corrected role selection passed fifteen actual-engine normal/low-car seat cases. Three rendered views with the layer disabled/enabled confirmed the passenger clip and retained driver recline without changing imported motion data.
records.limitations: Rendered opening-scene poses and native seat-role selection were checked; perfect wheel/seat contacts, all meshes and entry/exit transitions remain outside coverage. Game-derived inputs, captures, private receipts and runtime implementation are withheld from Workshop.
